description: This PHP class defines the entity 'EmpPicture' representing employee pictures in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for storing image data, file metadata, and ORM mapping details.

classes.name: EmpPicture
classes.description: Entity class representing employee pictures with properties for image data and associated metadata, mapped to the 'hs_hr_emp_picture' database table and using Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this picture.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this picture.

methods.name: getPicture
methods.description: Returns the picture data, either as a string or resource.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the picture.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the picture.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the picture.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the picture.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the picture file.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the picture file.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the picture.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the picture.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the picture.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the picture.

calls: Doctrine ORM annotations such as ORM	on
